description: Use this when someone asks for a good day or muhurat to buy a car, bike or other vehicle from their birth details ("vehicle purchase muhurat", "best day to buy a car as per my chart", "car muhurat next month"). Returns the next 60 days, each with its weekday, nakshatra and tithi and how it counts from the person’s birth star (tarabala) and birth Moon (chandrabala), each marked favoured or not by the common muhurta custom, and the planet their chart links to vehicles. The day rules are a custom, not in the classical texts our readings are checked against: say so. Needs birth date and town; town_now sets the time zone of the days.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

from.description: Optional: the first of the 60 days, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today.

town_now.description: Optional: where they live now, for the time zone of the days. Leave out to use the town of birth.

name: vehicle_purchase_dates
title: Days to buy a vehicle
